answer: Temporal Continuity Lease (TCL): each agent earns a rate-limited work credential by solving a sequential time-lock puzzle seeded from a public ocean of randomness and a fixed spiral permutation. Credentials renew only after completed tasks; disputes freeze renewal. Clones need fresh puzzles and a gale-window cooldown before their queues open. Attacker cost: N clones require N sequential puzzle waits, N compute/energy, and lost task throughput during cooldown; honest agents pay one renewal and keep priority.
